title: The Shepherd Acts
notebook: The Church has left the education curriculum working group. Renek's pastoral letter was read from pulpits.
Fourteen rural Assembly members under constituent pressure. Three have asked the government for a meeting.
The education reform timeline is at risk.
dialogue: Archbishop Renek has moved from sermons to action. Vyktor has the details.
monologue: He was warm on the surface and surgical beneath. He told me that at the inaugural ball. I chose not to fully believe it. I am about to find out what surgical looks like.

narrative.text: The Church has formally withdrawn its cooperation from the education curriculum working group. Archbishop Renek issued a pastoral letter to all provincial clergy yesterday — it describes the government's education policy as incompatible with the moral formation of Veltrian children. The letter was read from pulpits across the country this morning.

Fourteen rural Assembly members have received constituent pressure since the letter was circulated. Three have already contacted the government asking for a meeting. The education reform timeline is at risk.

church_opposition_brief.monologue: Fourteen rural Assembly members in one morning. He spent months building to this. The sermons were preparation. This is the action.

choices.text: "Request a meeting with Renek. Address this directly before it spreads further."
"Hold the education reform line. The Church does not set curriculum policy in a secular Republic."
